_doc: Pod kinds registry. Each pod 'kind' field used in the codebase has an entry here. `kg_admissible` controls whether kg_edge_metadata is allowed to reference this pod kind by URI — pod_store remains the sole source of truth for pod content (no kg_node mirror). The promoter calls pod_kind_registry.is_kg_admissible() before writing any edge with a `datapod:*` endpoint.
_canonical_example: Append a new entry to 'kinds' as a starting point for a new pod kind. See skills/extending-emi-pod-kinds/SKILL.md for the field reference.

image.description: Image artifact (PNG/JPEG/etc) posted to chat. Stored content-addressed under data/images/<sha>.<ext>. Body is populated by the vision-extraction pass (caption + OCR). Admissible to the KG because user-shared photos are referenced by entities/events ('Katy depicted_in datapod:image:...').

email.description: Inbound email. one_liner=subject, body=email body verbatim. Source refs back to the event_repository row.
email._doc_excluded_from_kg: Email content is noisy, sensitive, and token-heavy. Not referenced by KG edges.

chat_cluster.description: Resolved chat segment from pod_classifier with entity-anchored sections. Body is the resolved markdown sections.
chat_cluster._doc_excluded_from_kg: Chat clusters are conversation context, not facts. KG ingests facts extracted FROM clusters; clusters themselves are not KG citizens.

note.description: Freeform authored content pod — a user- or agent-curated note, list, or collection (e.g. a contacts/email list). one_liner=title, body=verbatim content. Minted on demand via the mint_pod tool.

service_loop.description: Internal pod_classifier service-loop placeholder. Not user-facing content; emitted to keep the pipeline running when there's nothing to classify.

_doc_chat_introduced: Pod source_kind values used by upstream code to mark pods that originated from user chat activity (uploads, attachments, manual mints). Kept for upstream codepaths that classify intake source; no longer drives KG admission (the kg_admissible flag on each kind is now the sole gate).
